verdict.rationale: AiPrise is an identity and business verification platform, so selfie-to-document matching with liveness detection is an applicable axis. The evidence pack never mentions selfie capture, face matching, or liveness defenses against printed photos, screens, or replayed video. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: mobile capture SDKs, document-tampering detection, and session/device linking.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, selfie checks match the live user to the document portrait with liveness detection — documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video
